data.name: Syringebound
data.detailed_description:
SURVIVE THE HORDE AND REPEAT

Syringebound is fast-paced, arcade style, retro aesthetic FPS. The goal is simple: survive the hordes of the undead.

Each wave gets more deadlier, more enemies will come and the enemies are tankier as well. To survive that you have unique mechanic: The Syringes. You can inject the syringe onto you to have additional perks and make yourself stronger. But be careful... overinjecting comes with consequences as well.

CURRENT FEATURES AS OF EARLY ACCESS

This game is currently in Early Access so the list of features will grow from time to time

  • 1 Map: A desolated island filled with fog, rocks and some leafless trees.

  • 3 Weapons: Pistol, Shotgun, Rifle.

  • 3 Syringes: Health, Reload and Stamina syringes.

  • 3 Enemy types: Standard Walkers, Fast Runners and Heavy Tanks.

  • Retro style: The game has old-school graphics with low poly models and dithering as well as color ramp map.

data.short_description: Syringebound is fast-paced, FPS game with retro aesthetics of PS1. Fight against horde of the undead, inject syringes to make yourself more powerful, buy weapons and try to survive as long as possible.
